scope: Fresh isolated local fixtures; attacker receives only dedicated ordinary relayer/funder fixture credentials. Admin, upgrade, mint and XMSS seed material excluded. Pending does not mean passed.
limitations: All public-cluster deployment and mint creation pending developer devnet funding.
Staged witness sealed-write mutation rejection and same-authority rotation rejection have source guards but no dedicated final runtime negative cases.
Raw benchmark logs include disposable local-only fixtures; those fixture seeds are never publicly funded.
Local v1 parser execution does not enforce inline resource budgets; custody measurements use enforced legacy ComputeBudget instructions.
